originalP0.finding: Actual original scorer consumed an identified empty received forest and the same empty ui_elements list as its original predicate. DeskClock passes activity gate, Start false/count0 returns false at line63; raw scorer0 equals saved0 despite paused-zero UI. Loss starts at creation before quit; later constructor-worker NPE is a separate failure.

capabilityProtection.finding: OriginalP1 uses same original APK with actual upstream/returned target capability true; stable bound forwarder/PID and 850 nonempty receives, selected846, original predicate true and reward1. OriginalP0 omits capability, becomes unbound and has 301 empty receives. This supports capability protection/coexistence in these sampled runs, not a population success rate or measured final numeric UiAutomation flags.

patchedRecoveryWithoutCapability.finding: When unbound during session, the current capture worker stops and host receives stop instead of receiving empty forests. At quit a new service instance in same process starts a new worker on retained endpoint, and nonempty trees resume and are actually scored. TID31303 reuse is coroutine dispatcher reuse, not old-worker continuity. This proves an observed stop/reconnect recovery mechanism in this APK, not isolation of lifecycle source changes from build-stack differences.

patchedProtection.actionDifference: 4 actions: Search click, input Clock, Clock click, Stopwatch tab click; other cells use drawer swipe, Clock click, Stopwatch tab click. No Start/Pause click, but navigation and observation/timing are not identical.
